Package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.tag

Interface TagService

public interface TagService
Represents a service for managing shop tags.

This service is responsible for:

  • Normalizing and displaying tags
  • Persisting tags to the database
  • Removing tags from shops
  • Toggling system-defined tags

Implementations are expected to connect directly to the database layer, while a tag manager handles in-memory indexing and caching.

Since:
6.3.0.0

  • Method Details

    • commandFromTag

      String commandFromTag(String stored, boolean list)
      Generates a command based on the provided tag value and list mode.
      Parameters:
      stored - The tag value as a String. If null, the fallback "tag list" command is returned.
      list - A boolean indicating whether the command should be in list format or not. If true, the method returns commands in the "list" format (e.g., "favorite list"). If false, it returns commands in single format (e.g., "favorite").
      Returns:
      A String representing the command based on the input stored and list values. Possible outputs include: - "tag list" if stored is null. - "favorite", "watch", or "avoid" (and their respective list forms) for predefined system tags. - "tag remove " for custom tags if list is false.
      Since:
      6.3.0.0

    • displayTag

      String displayTag(org.bukkit.entity.Player sender, String stored)
      Formats a stored tag for display to a player.

      System tags are converted into friendly display names, while custom tags are prefixed with a hash character.

      Parameters:
      sender - the player receiving the display value
      stored - the stored tag value
      Returns:
      the formatted display value, or an empty string if the tag is null
      Since:
      6.3.0.0

    • displayTagOrHash

      String displayTagOrHash(String stored)
      Formats a stored tag for display while preserving system tags.

      System tags beginning with @ are returned unchanged, while custom tags are prefixed with a hash character.

      Parameters:
      stored - the stored tag value
      Returns:
      the formatted tag, or an empty string if the tag is null
      Since:
      6.3.0.0

    • normalizeTag

      @Nullable @Nullable String normalizeTag(@Nullable @Nullable String input, boolean allowSystem)
      Normalizes a tag into its stored form.

      This includes trimming whitespace, lowercasing the value, removing a leading hash character, enforcing a maximum length, and validating allowed characters.

      Parameters:
      input - the input tag
      allowSystem - whether reserved system tags are allowed
      Returns:
      the normalized tag, or null if invalid
      Since:
      6.3.0.0

    • toggleSystemTag

      CompletableFuture<Boolean> toggleSystemTag(UUID player, long shopId, String tag)
      Toggles a reserved system tag on a shop for a player.

      If the tag does not exist it will be added. If it already exists it will be removed.

      Parameters:
      player - the player toggling the tag
      shopId - the shop id
      tag - the system tag
      Returns:
      a future containing true if the tag is enabled after the operation
      Since:
      6.3.0.0
